title: workflow_profile/v1
description: The compiled workflow policy. Nothing in this bundle validates JSON at runtime — adding a schema library would break the dependency-free rule — so scripts/workflow_profile.py:compile_profile being the only writer of these values is the enforcement, and tests/test_bundle.py asserts this file never drifts from its MODE_PROFILES table.

deployment.description: allowed is false in every compiled default; production deployment is an explicit opt-in and requires a delivery_target of staging or production.

safety_floor.description: Cumulative and never cuttable. An override may add entries; nothing removes one.
